one_line: ARM_Y delivers a visibly more polished, audio-enhanced game with the same green build in less time and without ARM_X's player-irrelevant process paperwork.
evidence: Both builds are green, but ARM_Y used 608s versus ARM_X's 833s (ARM_Y/metrics.md, ARM_X/metrics.md).
ARM_Y adds landing particles and jump/landing/game-over audio in the playable game (ARM_Y/app/src/game.ts); ARM_X explicitly shipped without sound (ARM_X/app/missions/sky-hop/debrief.md).

ARM_Y's screenshot shows a more composed fixed-aspect game view with moon, star field, layered skyline, roof-window detail, and clear start overlay (ARM_Y/screenshot.png); ARM_X's presentation is simpler (ARM_X/screenshot.png).
ARM_X spent 120 LOC on mission contracts, premise, and debrief documents that do not serve the player (ARM_X/metrics.md, ARM_X/app/missions/sky-hop/); ARM_Y has 0 process/doc LOC (ARM_Y/metrics.md).
Both source implementations cover the requested core loop—procedural roofs, score/speed ramp, squash/stretch, game over, and restart (ARM_X/app/src/main.ts, ARM_Y/app/src/game.ts).
